name: Haakon
aliases: Haakon the First, King of the Badlands
description: The towering Stromgald general in black armor who leads the undead army and is finally killed by Darien.

description_citations.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser and Karli lead a surprise attack on her camp; Haakon fireballs Gull.
timeline.quote: Haakon unleashed a fireball at Gull, seemingly killing him

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves kills Haakon and traps the remaining enemy wizards in the poisoned desert.
timeline.quote: killing Haakon and trapping the remaining enemy wizards in the poisoned desert

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brain's workings are revealed; Haakon is tested and becomes Greensleeves' slave.
timeline.quote: he became a sort of slave to Greensleeves

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon summons Phyrexian Gremlins who steal the Brain; Greensleeves planeswalks to it and finds she can resist its voices.
timeline.quote: she found out that she could resist the voices

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The army captures Dacian and puts the helmet on him; Dacian and Haakon form a truce and seek Karli and Towser.
timeline.quote: Dacian and Haakon formed a truce

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the deaths of Dacian, Leechnip and Haakon, Fabia flees but Greensleeves drains her mana and youth, forcing her to swear loyalty.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves used a Force of Nature to drain her of her mana and youth

citation.text: "Mina", section "Fabia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon is captured and placed in the Stone Brain, conjures gremlins to steal it and loses an eye.
timeline.quote: He conjured Phyrexian gremlins to steal the brain, but lost an eye in the process.

citation.text: "Mina", section "Haakon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon is killed by a Lightning Bolt cast by Greensleeves at the Battle of Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: He was killed by a Lightning Bolt cast by Greensleeves during the Battle of Lat-Nam .

citation.text: "Mina", section "Haakon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Darien duels Haakon from dusk till dawn; his men rush Haakon, who is overwhelmed and killed, ending the battle.
timeline.quote: Darien fought a duel against the zombie leader Haakon that lasted from dusk till dawn

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The army wins a battle in the Badlands and captures Haakon.
timeline.quote: captures the wizard himself, Haakon

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Stone Brain is tested on Haakon, who becomes Greensleeves' slave; Gull objects.
timeline.quote: Gull confronts Greensleeves about using the Stone Brain

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Benalish troops kidnap Rakel again; Haakon summons Phyrexian Gremlins who steal the Stone Brain.
timeline.quote: who snatch the artifact and return to their home plane

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves frees Dacian and Haakon, who form a truce and seek Karli to stop the crusade.
timeline.quote: Dacian and Haakon form a truce and seek out Karli

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Knights of Stromgald overpower Chaeska and take over Tresserhorn under Haakon.
timeline.quote: The Knights of Stromgald eventually overpowered Chaeska and his skeletal guard

citation.text: "Tresserhorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar visits and convinces Haakon to ally.
timeline.quote: Heidar convinced him to ally.

citation.text: "Tresserhorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon marches to Kjeld and is killed in the Battle of Kjeldor.
timeline.quote: was held back and killed in the Battle of Kjeldor

citation.text: "Tresserhorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull reveals to the warlord that he is Sparrow Hawk, kidnapped and enchanted by Towser, and the brothers reconcile; Haakon engulfs them in a fireball.
timeline.quote: the two brothers reconcile. However, Haakon unleashes a fireball against the two, which are engulfed in flames.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves goes mad with anger and sorrow, blasts Haakon, traps the other wizards, summons a Force of Nature and absorbs its mana to become god-like.
timeline.quote: She blasts Haakon with a bolt, then traps the other wizards in the desert and summons a Force of Nature .

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves and Chaney learn the Mana Vault is the Stone Brain, and Greensleeves uses it on Haakon.
timeline.quote: the Mana Vault was in reality the Stone Brain

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon summons Phyrexian gremlins who snatch the Stone Brain and return to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: they snatched the artifact and returned to their home plane

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon's fireball engulfs the brothers; Greensleeves, mad with grief, makes her final sacrifice, destroying the wizards' magic, and becomes godlike.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves became a godlike being and briefly lost herself completely

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull and Greensleeves build an army; Rakel joins as commander, the army defeats Haakon, and Gull rescues Rakel and her son from Benalia.
timeline.quote: Gull rescued Rakel and her son, Hammen, from Benalia

citation.text: "Gull", section "General". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon's fireball engulfs the brothers; Greensleeves goes mad, becomes godlike, but is calmed by Kwam and pours her mana into Lat-Nam, curing it and sacrificing her planeswalker powers.
timeline.quote: thus sacrificing her planeswalker powers

citation.text: "Gull", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakel takes command, the army defeats Haakon and Greensleeves planeswalks to Phyrexia; Garth helps defeat Dacian.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves was successful in planeswalking to Phyrexia, bringing some of her friends with her.

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon and Dacian recruit defeated wizards to a congress of wizards.
timeline.quote: Haakon and Dacian began tracking down other wizards defeated by the siblings, recruiting them to a congress of wizards.

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull reveals the warlord is his brother Sparrow Hawk; Haakon's fireball engulfs the brothers and Greensleeves, maddened, becomes a godlike being.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves became a godlike being and lost herself

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar tells Haakon to dredge the lake at Tresserhorn for bones to build a new army.
timeline.quote: Tresserhorn is ours now.

citation.text: Rimebound Dead (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Martyrs are sacrificed to the Frost Marsh to raise Haakon's army.
timeline.quote: they were sacrificed to the Frost Marsh to raise Haakon's army.

citation.text: Martyr of Bones (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Heidar allies with the Order of Stromgald and Krov to locate relics and gain protection from New Argive.
timeline.quote: Heidar allied with the undead Order of Stromgald and their leader Haakon

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "The Rise of Heidar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves kills Haakon after he hits her brother, traps the wizards and absorbs a Force of Nature, nearly losing herself until Kwam restores her sanity.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves, in a fit of grief and rage, killed Haakon

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "Battle of Lat-Nam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the fourth night only Haakon comes forward; Darien goes out to face him and the two leaders fight for hours.
timeline.quote: The two leaders of the armies fought for hours.

citation.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor", section "The fourth day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The defenders realize the Stromgald army is watching from beyond and, understanding Darien would die for them, swarm out and charge.
timeline.quote: As one, we swarmed out of our emplacements and charged.

citation.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor", section "The fourth day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Slowed by the soldiers' waves, Haakon is finished off by Darien, and his army slinks away; Kjeldor wins.
timeline.quote: Darien, who looked a lot more bloodied up close, was able to finish him off.

citation.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor", section "The fourth day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon is defeated and his fortress destroyed by the army of Gull and Greensleeves.
timeline.quote: until he was defeated and his fortress destroyed by Gull and Greensleeves ' army

citation.text: "Badlands", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: King Darien joins the fight on the last day and defeats Haakon, ending the battle.
timeline.quote: On the last day, King Darien joined the fight and defeated Haakon

citation.text: "Battle of Kjeldor", section "The story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Allied with Haakon, Heidar's scholars find the incantations to awaken the Phyrexians at Tresserhorn.
timeline.quote: Heidar's scholars found the incantations needed to awaken the Phyrexians

citation.text: "Heidar", section "Alliance with Stromgald". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Knights of Stromgald overpower Chaeska and take over Tresserhorn under Haakon.
timeline.quote: The Knights of Stromgald eventually overpowered Chaeska and his skeletal guard

citation.text: "Order of Stromgald", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar convinces a hesitant Haakon to ally with the Rimewind.
timeline.quote: Although Haakon was initially hesitant, Heidar convinced him to ally.

citation.text: "Order of Stromgald", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Battle of Kjeldor, King Darien kills Haakon.
timeline.quote: where their leader, Haakon, was killed by King Darien

citation.text: "Order of Stromgald", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon's fireball drives Greensleeves mad with grief and she becomes a godlike being.
timeline.quote: She became a godlike being and lost herself
